apps.title: XBSX2 · PlayStation 2
apps.description: A native PS2 emulator with separate CPU builds for the two Xbox generations.
apps.requirements: Dump a BIOS from your own PS2 and select it in the first-run wizard. Set the installed app type to Game in Developer Home. Xbox One uses SSE4; the AVX2 build is for Series S/X and crashes on Xbox One.

apps.title: RetroPass · library frontend
apps.description: A controller-friendly native library frontend that launches separately installed emulators. It does not include emulator cores, games or an artwork scraper.
apps.requirements: Install the native MSIX and its bundled x64 dependencies. Prepare a supported LaunchBox or EmulationStation library with metadata and artwork on external storage using a computer. Install LaunchBox directly on that external drive; moving an already configured PC installation breaks paths. Install and configure the target Xbox emulators separately before linking them in RetroPass.
apps.paths: In RetroPass Settings → Sources select the LaunchBox/EmulationStation metadata directory, Add, then Activate. EmulationStation uses RetroPass.xml at the drive root with a relative EmulationStation path and per-system gamelist.xml files. Follow the documented directory layout; NTFS is recommended for saving RetroPass.xml.
